name: jiachen-skills
description: Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex: find repeated manual work, write Anki flashcards, review skills, produce Chinese content.

plugins.name: lifting-loops
plugins.description: Find the loops where you keep acting as a manual step for your agents (retrying, approving, carrying context) and get concrete fixes: skill edits, scripts, scheduled tasks.

plugins.name: making-content
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-sounding Chinese drafts in a restrained style, and produce Xiaohongshu (小红书) image posts and short vertical videos.

plugins.name: making-flashcards
plugins.description: Turn a conversation, your notes, or a research topic into Anki flashcards, deduplicated against your local Anki collection.

plugins.name: review-skill
plugins.description: Audit an Agent Skill against Anthropic's official best practices and get a Must Fix / Should Consider report with file:line fixes.
